points.description: States that the design flood is the flood (peak flow/discharge magnitude) adopted or selected for the design of structures (e.g., dams, spillways, bridges, culverts).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the answer only vaguely describes it as a flood of some large magnitude or a flood used for planning, without linking it to designing structures.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for the idea that the design flood is the flood chosen/adopted for designing structures, in any wording. Give 1 mark if the answer is vague, e.g. just a large or maximum flood, or a flood used for planning, without clearly linking it to design. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the core idea.
